name: Alkenstar Outlaw
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One boost must be to **Dexterity** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Thievery and Underworld Lore. You gain the [Subtle Theft](/feat/subtle-theft-player-core) skill feat.

name: Alkenstar Sojourner
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Society and Engineering Lore. You gain the [Streetwise](/feat/streetwise-player-core) skill feat.

name: Anti-Tech Activist
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Guild Lore skill. You gain the [Group Coercion](/feat/group-coercion-player-core) skill feat.

name: Back-Alley Doctor
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Risky Surgery](/feat/risky-surgery-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Cannoneer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One boost must be to **Dexterity** or **Strength**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the [Hefty Hauler](/feat/hefty-hauler-player-core) skill feat.

name: Circuit Judge
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Deception and Legal Lore. You gain the [Lie To Me](/feat/lie-to-me-player-core) skill feat.

name: Clockfighter
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Gladiatorial Lore skill. You gain the [Experienced Professional](/feat/experienced-professional-player-core) skill feat.

name: Clockwork Researcher
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the [Crafter'S Appraisal](/feat/crafter-s-appraisal-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Codebreaker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Cryptography Lore skill. You gain the [Glean Contents](/feat/glean-contents-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Deputy
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the [Experienced Tracker](/feat/experienced-tracker-player-core) skill feat.

name: Discarded Duplicate
descr:
You and the GM can work out how to incorporate your previous life into your story. The GM can keep this knowledge [Hidden](/condition/hidden-player-core) even from you, or you or another character know what happened. You and the GM can also leave the information unspecified and fill it in later.

You gain three free attribute boosts. You choose two, and the GM chooses one based on the attributes of the character you were built to duplicate.

name: Disciple of the Gear
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Lore skill for the deity you worship. You gain the [Quick Repair](/feat/quick-repair-player-core) skill feat.

name: Driver
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Acrobatics skill and either the Driving Lore or Piloting Lore skill. You gain the [Assurance](/feat/assurance-player-core) skill feat with the chosen lore.

name: Farmsteader
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Farming Lore skill. You gain the [Forager](/feat/forager-player-core) skill feat.

name: Fireworks Performer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Fireworks Lore skill. You gain the [Fascinating Performance](/feat/fascinating-performance-player-core) skill feat.

name: Goldhand Arms Dealer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Diplomacy and Mercantile Lore. You gain the [Group Impression](/feat/group-impression-player-core) skill feat.

name: Gunsmith
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One of these boosts must be to **Intelligence** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the [Quick Repair](/feat/quick-repair-player-core) skill feat.

name: Hired Killer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One boost must be to **Strength** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Terrain Stalker](/feat/terrain-stalker-player-core) skill feat, choosing a terrain appropriate for where you make your kills.

name: Hounded Thief
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Thievery skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the [Pickpocket](/feat/pickpocket-player-core) skill feat.

name: Junk Collector
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and your choice of either the Engineering Lore or Mining Lore skill. You gain the [Crafter'S Appraisal](/feat/crafter-s-appraisal-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Junker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Lore skill of the terrain in which you scavenge. You gain the [Hefty Hauler](/feat/hefty-hauler-player-core) skill feat.

name: Mechanic
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the [Quick Repair](/feat/quick-repair-player-core) skill feat.

name: Mechanical Symbiosis
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Arcana skill and an additional skill in which the clockwork entity is well-versed, determined by the GM. Any time you attempt a skill check for the entity's skill, the GM can offer you a +1 circumstance bonus to the check, as though the entity were Aiding you. If you accept but fail the check, the entity clenches up and you are [Stunned 1](/condition/stunned-player-core) (Stunned 2 on a critical failure).

name: Medicinal Clocksmith
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and the Engineering Lore skill. You gain the [Risky Surgery](/feat/risky-surgery-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Otherworldly Mission
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Wisdom** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Religion. Once per adventure, you can ask the voice you believe to be a deity for orders and get some kind of instruction-you never get any kind of explanation, simply a command to go somewhere or do something. Following those commands isn't always safe, but it's usually interesting.

name: Press-Ganged (G&G)
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Constitution**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the [Armor Assist](/feat/armor-assist-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Printer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill and the Scribing Lore skill. You gain the [Multilingual](/feat/multilingual-player-core) skill feat.

name: Revenant
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Religion and Boneyard Lore. You're still alive, not undead, but you have the void healing ability, which means you're harmed by vitality damage and healed by void effects as if you were undead.

name: Saloon Entertainer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Charisma** or **Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and a lore skill of your choice. You gain the [Virtuosic Performer](/feat/virtuosic-performer-player-core) skill feat.

name: Saved by Clockwork
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill. Every day you must perform 10 minutes of maintenance and wind up your clockwork parts, or you risk failure of the components, with consequences depending on what you replaced (determined by you and the GM). Your clockwork components allow you to react to danger with alacrity. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

name: Sheriff
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the [Group Coercion](/feat/group-coercion-player-core) skill feat.

name: Spotter
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Dexterity** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Scouting Lore skill. You gain the [Terrain Stalker](/feat/terrain-stalker-player-core) skill feat.

name: Tall Tale
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Performance. You gain the [Impressive Performance](/feat/impressive-performance-player-core) skill feat. You can gain the [Leverage Connections](/feat/leverage-connections-player-core-2) skill feat later without being expert in Society or having Courtly Graces-this represents less traditional social connections and more the way that your legend has spread, and you've learned to leverage your legend, with people wanting to meet you and see you for themselves.

name: Tech-Reliant
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Intelligence**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Medicine skill. You gain the [Battle Medicine](/feat/battle-medicine-player-core) skill feat, and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells. Healing spells, healing magic items, and magical effects with the [healing](/trait/healing) trait have no effect on you.

name: Toymaker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Mercantile Lore skill. You gain the [Specialty Crafting](/feat/specialty-crafting-player-core) skill feat, choosing Artistry, Blacksmithing, Glassmaking, Leatherworking, Tailoring, or Woodworking as your specialty.

name: Undertaker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill and a Lore skill specializing in one local type of undead. You gain the [Forensic Acumen](/feat/forensic-acumen-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Wandering Preacher
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One boost must be to **Constitution** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Religion skill and a Lore skill associated with the deity you preach for (such as Pharasmin Lore). You gain the [Pilgrim'S Token](/feat/pilgrim-s-token-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Waste Walker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One boost must be to **Strength** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill, and Mana Wastes Lore (or another similar Lore skill associated with the wastes where you grew up). You gain the [Forager](/feat/forager-player-core) skill feat.

name: Wished Alive
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Constitution** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill. Once per day, you can fervently wish for something you could work towards achieving as a single action which has the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait. If you do, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the first skill check you attempt before the end of your turn to fulfill that wish.
